tags.fixme: Check boundaries at Gdańsk and Toruń; Several missing starts: Lingen (1713), Tecklenburg (1707), Neuchâtel (1707-1806), E. Vorpommern (1720)
tags.name: Königreich Preußen
tags.start_date:changes: Annexed West Prussia (excluding Danzig/Gdańsk and Thorn/Toruń) and the Netze District; Lauenburg, Bütow and Draheim become sovereign territory
tags.start_date:note: Treaty of partiton signed by Russia, Prussia and Austria 1772-08-05 and ratified 1772-09-22; Treaty of cession signed by the Commonwealth (renouncing its claims) 1773-09-18
